rubricRevision.previousNegativeExtreme: Explicit legal hunting continuation/defence with operative hunting permits.
rubricRevision.rationale: The proposition asks about a general ban, not permit design. Direct explicit defence/promotion of hunting opposes that ban while environmental regulation remains possible. A documented licence is evidence of continuation, not a mandatory extra condition for every programme. Existing PACMA and VOX values unchanged.

limitations: All six original image pages reread visually. Only all five policy paragraphs on page 2 are manually transcribed and checked; no full-document native extraction or OCR claim.
